title: Causal order of single-cell readings on a contract chain

key_results.statement: Outcome-averaged influence: $\Delta_t=P_j(t\mid R_i)-P_j(t)=\langle\Psi_1\vert\mathcal M_i(Q_t)-Q_t\vert\Psi_1\rangle$ with $Q_t=e^{\mathrm iC\delta}\Pi'_te^{-\mathrm iC\delta}$ and $\mathcal M_i(X)-X=\sum_s\Pi_s[X,\Pi_s]$.
No influence without delay: $P_j(\cdot\mid R_i)=P_j(\cdot)$ whenever $\lambda_2\le\lambda_1$, for all cells $i,j$, starts and readings.
Only the nested commutator $K_t=\mathrm{ad}_{J_{i-1}}\cdots\mathrm{ad}_{J_j}\Pi'_t$ (mirror for $i<j$) of order $r$ fails to commute with $\Pi_s$; all lower orders commute.

$\Delta_t=\Gamma_t\delta^r+O(\delta^{r+1})$ with $\Gamma_t=\frac{1}{r!}\langle\Psi_1\vert\mathcal M_i(\mathrm i^rK_t)-\mathrm i^rK_t\vert\Psi_1\rangle=\frac{1}{r!}\mathrm{Tr}[(\mathcal M_i(V)-V)\mathrm i^rK_t]$, independent of the $D_m$.
The lowest power of the influence is $\delta^r$: $\delta P=\delta^r\sum_t\lvert\Gamma_t\rvert+O(\delta^{r+1})$.

Qubit chain $J_1=g\sigma^x_1\sigma^x_2$, $J_m=g\sigma^z_m\sigma^x_{m+1}$, start $\lvert+\rangle\lvert{+\mathrm i}\rangle^{\otimes r}$: $\delta P=(2g\delta)^r/r!+O(\delta^{r+1})$ for every $r\ge1$ (r=1: $2g\delta$; r=2: $2g^2\delta^2$).

Chain Lieb–Robinson bound: $\lVert[A(\delta),B]\rVert\le2\lVert A\rVert\lVert B\rVert\sum_{k\ge r}(2\lVert J\rVert\delta)^k/k!$ for $A$ on cell $j$, $B$ on cell $i$, uniform in $n$ and independent of the $D_i$.

For every start, readings and $\delta\ge0$: $\delta P\le2(1-1/m)\sum_{k\ge r}(2\lVert J\rVert\delta)^k/k!\le2(2\lVert J\rVert\delta)^re^{2\lVert J\rVert\delta}/r!$; the bound does not depend on the $D_i$.
$\delta P$ is built from entire functions of $\delta$: if $\delta P=0$ on $(0,\varepsilon)$ then $\delta P=0$ for all $\delta\ge0$.
No sharp light cone: the delays with influence, $\mathcal I_{ij}$, are either empty or $(0,\infty)\setminus E_{ij}$ with $E_{ij}$ discrete and $E_{ij}\cap(0,\delta_0)=\emptyset$.
$\delta P<\epsilon$ for every start on $\mathcal S_\epsilon=\{(r,\delta):2\sum_{k\ge r}(2\lVert J\rVert\delta)^k/k!<\epsilon\}=\{\delta<\delta_\epsilon(r)\}$.
For $v>2e\lVert J\rVert$ and $\delta\le r/v$: $\delta P\le\frac{2}{1-2\lVert J\rVert/v}(2e\lVert J\rVert/v)^r$.
The boundary of $\mathcal S_\epsilon$ moves at $\lim_{r\to\infty}r/\delta_\epsilon(r)=v_{\rm LR}=2e\lVert J\rVert$ cells per unit $\lambda$, independent of $\epsilon$, $n$ and the $D_i$.
$(i,\lambda_1)\prec(j,\lambda_2)$ iff some reading at $(i,\lambda_1)$ influences some reading at $(j,\lambda_2)$ for some start.

For fixed cells and fixed $\lambda_1<\lambda_2$, $e_1\prec e_2$ for all contract terms outside a closed null set; for fixed $C$ it fails only at delays in the discrete set $E_{ij}$, which can be nonempty.
$\prec$ is not transitive in general: for $n=2$, $J_1=g\sigma^x_1\sigma^x_2$, $(1,0)\prec(2,\pi/4g)\prec(1,\pi/2g)$ but $(1,0)\nprec(1,\pi/2g)$.

open_issues: Whether the exceptional delay sets E_ij are empty for generic contract terms (so that ≺ equals the λ order and is transitive) is not decided; a dimension count suggests yes.
v_LR = 2e‖J‖ is the speed of the bound's ε-boundary; the actual front speed of a given chain may be lower and is not determined; the bound is shown tight only at leading order.
Out of scope: events defined by records, sequences of more than two readings, other contract graphs, relation to the maximal speed of 03-ilang-space, detectability of the λ order (criterion 8).

consistency_checks.check: Cut link J_m = 0 between the cells: δP ≡ 0 exactly, consistent with K_t = 0, the vanishing recursion behind the commutator bound, and an empty delay set
n = 2 exact solution δP = |sin 2gδ|: leading term 2gδ matches the order-r formula, lies below the bound e^{2gδ} − 1, zeros isolated
Limit δ → 0 continuous with the no-delay result, Σ_t Γ_t = 0, and dimensions: ‖J‖δ dimensionless, v_LR in cells per unit λ
